## Counterexamples

### a_no_fence

(a) tail read without the fence

Violates `I4_NoGapAtSeam`.

1. registerStream(s0, inc 1)
2. ledger drain: PUT segment v1..v1
3. registration logged -> s0 accepts writes
4. append(b0 -> s0) seq 1
5. seal(s0, ..1)
6. flush: pendingSegments(s0) -> inc 1 1..1
7. flush readSegment(s0 inc 1 1..1)
8. flush PUT L0(s0 inc1 1..1)
9. ledger drain: delete outbox rows v1..v1, advance logged
10. query: plan (no files; wm s0:inc1@0)
11. addUnit(s0 inc 1 1..1) admitted
12. ledger drain: PUT segment v2..v2
13. ledger drain: delete outbox rows v2..v2, advance logged
14. recorded(s0, ..1)
15. discard(s0, ..1)
16. query: tailRead(s0, inc 1, above 0) = ok nothing
17. query: read files, merge -> nothing

### b_highest_seq

(b) watermark = highest seq seen, not the contiguous prefix

Violates `I4_NoGapAtSeam`.

1. registerStream(s0, inc 1)
2. ledger drain: PUT segment v1..v1
3. registration logged -> s0 accepts writes
4. append(b0 -> s0) seq 1
5. seal(s0, ..1)
6. append(b1 -> s0) seq 2
7. seal(s0, ..2)
8. flush: pendingSegments(s0) -> inc 1 2..2
9. flush readSegment(s0 inc 1 2..2)
10. flush PUT L0(s0 inc1 2..2)
11. addUnit(s0 inc 1 2..2) admitted
12. query: plan (L0(s0 inc1 2..2); wm s0:inc1@2)
13. query: tailRead(s0, inc 1, above 2) = ok nothing
14. query: read files, merge -> b1

### b_highest_seq_I1

(b) same, as data loss

Violates `I1_AckedIsDurable`.

1. registerStream(s0, inc 1)
2. ledger drain: PUT segment v1..v1
3. registration logged -> s0 accepts writes
4. append(b0 -> s0) seq 1
5. seal(s0, ..1)
6. append(b1 -> s0) seq 2
7. seal(s0, ..2)
8. flush: pendingSegments(s0) -> inc 1 2..2
9. flush readSegment(s0 inc 1 2..2)
10. flush PUT L0(s0 inc1 2..2)
11. addUnit(s0 inc 1 2..2) admitted
12. ledger drain: delete outbox rows v1..v1, advance logged
